translated: With that, let's play a song.
This song features Shizuku as the lead, and I hope you can feel the changing weather of her heart as you listen along.
For this episode, we asked for listener mail on this theme:
"Things to look forward to in autumn."
The summer heat is still lingering, but autumn will be here before we know it.
So, we asked everyone to send in what they're looking forward to this fall.
Let's get right into the mail.
This one is from Radio name: Freshly Fried Fries.
"What I'm looking forward to in autumn is the maple leaves."
"I'm going to Kyoto in September to see the foliage."
"I usually go to Kyoto in the summer, so this is my first time going in the fall."
"I've seen photos of the leaves at places like Kiyomizu-dera and thought they were beautiful,"
"so I'm really excited to go see them for myself."
I have, I have, I have.
